direction: Young adult women with Japanese/Korean fashion-editorial styling and youthful energy. Long black hair with wispy bangs, white blouse and relaxed library setting with a cobalt ceramic squared arch. Full-viewport images alternate with separate content sections.

steps.prompt:
Create original photographic artwork for the Carrel infrastructure product, part of the zyx Made series. Contemporary Japanese and Korean editorial photography, natural physical materials, restrained styling, calm ordinary study spaces with one unexpected geometric object. Carrel's object is a cobalt blue glazed ceramic squared arch, shaped like an inverted U with thick rounded edges, two straight vertical legs, one wide horizontal top bridge, and an open rectangular void reaching the floor. Keep this exact silhouette consistent. No text, letters, logos, watermarks, signage, labels, arrows, diagrams, captions, interface, collage, borders or graphic bands. Soft directional daylight, gentle direct flash, subtle lens softness, realistic details. The final images will receive film grain in postproduction, do not exaggerate noise.

Use case: product-mockup. A single freestanding oversized cobalt ceramic squared arch sculpture on a quiet pale warm-gray seamless floor. Three-quarter frontal view, modest depth, rounded edges and believable glossy ceramic reflections, slightly imperfect glaze. Exact shape: one wide flat top bridge and two parallel legs, all connected, an inverted squared U with a fully open bottom. Outer top corners softly rounded. Center it, fill 70 percent of the square frame, with generous breathing room and soft cast shadow. Elegant physical object photography, no other objects, no people. Deep blue glaze, no metallic chrome, no text.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Image 1 is a casting and fashion mood reference only, do not copy its person or scene. Image 2 is the exact cobalt ceramic arch material/silhouette reference. Create an original beautiful 22-year-old adult female fashion model with an unmistakably youthful early-twenties look, long straight jet-black hair past her chest and soft wispy bangs, fresh dewy skin, light natural makeup and a lively direct gaze, styled like a contemporary Tokyo/Seoul independent fashion editorial. She wears a crisp white short-sleeved blouse, a charcoal pleated skirt, white crew socks and simple black loafers, not an office shirt or business trousers. At a sunlit pale-oak library study desk, she sits casually sideways on a wooden chair, one hand relaxed on the desk, the other resting naturally in her lap. The large cobalt ceramic arch stands securely on the desk beside her, separate from her hands. Slight informal posture, relaxed confident expression. Medium-wide environmental fashion portrait, whole seated pose visible, not a stiff corporate headshot. Subject and arch together occupy the left 56 percent, subject face around x=38%, y=37%. The right 40 percent is an empty pale plaster wall for live headline. Keep top edge quiet and bright, do not crop head or arch. Soft cool daylight mixed with gentle direct flash, clear facial features, no harsh age-accentuating shadows.

videos.prompt: A near-still five-second living editorial photograph. Locked camera. Preserve this exact young adult woman, youthful face, long straight black hair with wispy bangs, white short-sleeved blouse, charcoal skirt, seated pose and relaxed expression. Only one subtle natural blink and barely perceptible breathing. No head turn, smile change, hand or leg movement. The cobalt glazed ceramic squared arch stays completely rigid and stationary, with unchanged two legs, broad bridge and open bottom, surface and contact points. Keep desk, chair, clothing, hands, hair length and pale wall identical. No zoom, camera movement, reframing or new objects or text. End in the precise starting pose for a quiet loop.

postprocess.notes: Film treatment adapted from approved Made photo grading, with temporal grain and blur scaled to the native video resolution.

videos.loop_note: Small natural pose changes remain between the first and last frames.
